eyebrow: From a rate to a headcount
From a headcount to a dollar figure
code:
SELECT AVG(AnnualSpend) AS AvgAnnualCustomerValue
FROM ( SELECT CustomerID, SUM(OrderTotal) AS AnnualSpend
       FROM Sales.Orders WHERE OrderTotal > 0
       GROUP BY CustomerID ) AS PerCustomer;

-- ~$340 avg x 1,580 churned ≈ $537,000 revenue at risk
caption: An estimate of revenue at risk, not a guaranteed loss.
